Market today:
The mood is cautious. The Fed held rates steady, but a divided vote and talk of a September hike signal a hawkish undertone. The real driver for your book is Microsoft's earnings after the bell, with all eyes on their AI spending plans.

Your holdings:
SOXL is down a massive -63.82% and SPAL -57.7%; both are leveraged ETFs with wide default stops that need immediate attention. SMH is also down -20.75%. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch:
Keep a close eye on Microsoft's AI capex comments tonight. Also, monitor any further Fed commentary on a potential September rate hike.

Bottom line:
Tonight's tech earnings and managing your leveraged positions are your top priorities.
plays: Re-evaluate stops for leveraged SOXL (-63.82%) and SPAL (-57.7%). Their current stops are too wide given their decay and margin amplification.
QQQ is near its stop at 670. Respect this level to manage further downside on your core tech exposure.
Watch MSFT earnings closely. If AI capex outlook is strong, consider the scanner's long setup: entry 392-391.61, stop 390.88.
